html:
Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of the MARVEL Future Fight Team.
 
Hydra’s leaders have appeared in MARVEL Future Fight!
Now, let me clue you in on the details of the February update inspired by <Secret Empire>! 

 

3 New Characters and 4 New Uniforms are joining the world of MARVEL Future Fight! 
Baron Zemo, Viper, and Taskmaster have arrived!
Through a reality warp, Captain America transforms into a villain with his new Hydra Supreme Uniform!
Plus, feast your eyes on the new looks of the powerful Red Skull, Doctor Octopus, and Crossbones new Uniforms.

 

Additionally, Taskmaster, Baron Zemo, Viper, Doctor Octopus, and Sin will have their potential unlocked!
Red Skull and Doctor Octopus will have Awakened Skills!
Plus, the specialist Winter Soldier has been prepared to receive a Tier-3 upgrade in order to take on this villainous organization!

 

A variety of content improvements for Character Battle have been made!
The ability to select matching time zones, new special features, and upgraded Rank Rewards are here! Alliance Conquest!
Take on the enhanced Frost Beast and challenge yourself to reach for the new score cap! An improved Alliance Battle!
Experience the Danger Room without a breakout system with a variety of new cooperative elements!
In addition, various errors have been resolved in Story, Dimension Mission, and Alliance.

 

▣ 3 New Characters

 

The major Hydra leaders, Baron Zemo and Viper,
as well as the criminal copycat, Taskmaster, have arrived!
Take advantage of these three Villains’ combat abilities!

 

 

 

 

 

* New Character Skills are based on Level 1 stats.

 

▣ 4 New Uniforms

 

The new Uniforms for Captain America, Red Skull, Doctor Octopus, and Crossbones 
are inspired by the <Secret Empire> comic!
Use these powerful Villains to help you in your battles!

 

* New Uniform Skills are based on Level 1 stats.
* The 4 new Uniforms will be on sale during the event and will be available for purchase in the MARVEL Universe and Uniform Room after the event.

 

▣ 5 Characters can now Realize their Potential! Plus new Tier-3 Character!

 

Baron Zemo, Viper, Taskmaster, Doctor Octopus, and Sin have had their Potentials unlocked and will be able to reach level 70 after the February Update.

 

 

If that’s not exciting enough, Winter Soldier can now reach level 70!
The longtime friend of Captain America and expert assassin, Winter Soldier has awakened with a new ability through Tier-3 advancement.

 

 

 

​​​▣ New and Improved Awakened Skills

 

Red Skull and Doctor Octopus have new Awakened Skills. Plus, the Warriors of the Sky have had their Awakened skills improved! 
Check out the new 6th active skills! 

 

If you’re wondering how to awaken a character’s potential, look no further! Check out the guide below!

▣ Alliance Conquest

 

The place where the most character battles can be seen!
Take it over with your Alliance! Come and experience the newly improved Alliance Conquest.
Go check out the upgraded Ranking and Contribution Rewards and use that motivation to prepare for new battles!

 

1. Apply for your desired Alliance Conquest Time before the battle begins.

 

This feature to select a compatible time period has been added to better serve the Agents around the world!
 

- The Alliance Conquest time period can be selected during the Application Period.
- Please note that the Alliance Conquest will be divided according to the selected time zone. You will be matched with other Agents who have selected the same time zone.

 

* To ensure that everyone will have even matches, the duration of the Conquest period has been increased by 18 hours.
Previous Duration: Friday 3:00 PM- Tuesday 2:59 PM (UTC+0)
                               Friday 7:00 AM - Tuesday 6:59 AM (PST)
New Duration: Friday 3:00 PM - Wednesday 8:59 AM (UTC+0)
                         Friday 3:00 PM - Wednesday 12:59 AM (PST)
* The application period before Alliance Conquest remains unchanged. 
Application period: Thursday 3:00 PM - Friday 2:59 PM (UTC+0)
                                 Thursday 7:00 AM - Friday 6:59 AM (PST)
* The settlement period has been changed from Wednesday at 9:00 AM (UTC+0) | 1:00 AM (PST)  to Thursday 2:59 PM (UTC+0) | 6:59 AM (PST).
 

2. The Special Function <Stop Attack> has been added.

 

Use this function to signal to your Allies to not attack in a specific area during the battle.
A mark will be displayed for 20 minutes in the area where the Stop Attack is used.

 

 

 

[Stop Attack Details]

1. It is available only during Battle.

2. It can be used in attackable areas that are not occupied by Allies.

3. Only the Alliance Leader and Class 1 Allies can use Stop Attack.

 

- The Stop Attack function can be canceled by using a Support Request.
- A Support Request can be canceled by using the Stop Attack function where the support was requested!
* The cooldown of Stop Attack is 10 seconds and it costs 500 Assemble Points per use.

 

3. The cooldown and cost for some special abilities has been adjusted.

 

3. Alliance Conquest Rewards have been improved.
 
The Ranking Rewards and Contribution Rewards have been improved.

 

- Ranking Reward: Receive more Gold for higher scores.
- Contribution Reward: The items available in the Contribution Reward box have been upgraded.

 

- The list of obtainable rewards in Alliance Conquest can now be viewed thanks to this UI improvement!
- You will gain more rewards the more you play Alliance Conquest!
* The updated ranking and contribution rewards will be applied starting with the first Alliance Conquest to be held after this update.

 

5. Made improvements to the Alliance Conquest UI in order to improve information readability.

 

Various improvements to Alliance Conquest are being prepared, including adding matching and progression rules!

 

▣ Alliance Battle Improvements


For those Agents who are always striving to push the limits and enter Alliance Tournaments, we are pleased to introduce Alliance Battles with improved scoring and convenience!

 

Take on the more powerful Frost Beasts and challenge your revised high score!

 

1.The score limit in Extreme or Challenge mode has been increased. 
Existing: 3,500,000 → Updated: 10,000,000

Alliance Battle Extreme had a maximum score limit of 7,000,000 applied.
This was corrected through the 2/12 patch. Please see the patch notice for more details. 

[Go to the Patch Notice]
[Added on: 4/6 6:05 a.m. (UTC +0) / 4/05 11:05 p.m. (PDT)]
 

2. In Extreme Mode, the Frost Beast damage reduction buffs applied to Roar have been increased.

* The All Damage reduction buff effect increases in proportion to the accumulated damage to Frost Beast by 50%, 70%, and 90%.
If the accumulated damage is insufficient, the amount applied will be lower than 50%, 70%, and 90%.

 

3. The issue where a Frost Beast used Roar in Extreme mode but the All Damage reduction buff was not applied due to Temptation, Fascination, Time Freeze, Mind Control, or Paralysis effects has been fixed.


4. Improvements have been made to highlight the information about the current mode in the lobby.

 

 

6. The Meteor avoidance score display in Meteor Mode has been improved.

 

 

7. The results screen has been improved to clearly display the score.

 

 

▣ Other Alliance Content Improvements

 

[Alliance Tournament]

▶ An in-game guide has been added for entry conditions.

▶ Cheering has been enabled on the Scoreboard.


 

▶ Improvements have been made to the Alliance Tournament cheering screen to clearly show the cheering percentages and rewards.

 

[Etc.]

▶ Alliance Conquest and Alliance Tournament battles, and replays now support AR.

▶ Some icons have been improved in the Alliance Content and a help guide has been added.

 

▣ Danger Room Improvement
 
Various improvements have been made to enjoy the real-time cooperative content in Danger Room!
Enter the Danger Room for more strategic control and collaboration!

 

1. The Danger Room cycle has been changed from 7 days to 28 days.
- Stage and Character Changes / Ranking Rewards will be paid every Monday, as before, and the match score and records will reset every 28 Days.

 

2. The breakout system has been removed.
- The possibility of re-entering for a certain period of time when the Danger Room match ends due to disconnection has been improved!
 

3. Exclusive Skill and Skill Energy have been improved.

 

- New Exclusive Skills have been added.

 

▶ Berserk: Greatly enhances the attack and critical strike rates over a period of time.

▶ Black Sun: Generate a Black Sun for the opposing team. If the Black Sun explodes, it will cast a debuff on the opponent.

▶ Overpower: Restricts one of your opponent’s characters from using one Character Skill.

 

 

 

- Dedicated Skill gauges have been improved to charge with each Character Skill use.

 

- A new kind of Skill Energy has been added.

▶ Blue Skill Energy: The gauge is charged to use a dedicated skill.

▶ Gold Skill Energy: When acquired, one Exclusive Skill will be invoked at random.

 

- When the skill gauge is full, only Gold Skill Energy will be acquired!

 

4. An Inactivity Penalty and a Cumulative Participation Bonus have been added.
 
The Danger Room cycle has been extended to 28 days with longer retention periods, with added bonuses for cumulative participation and penalties for inactivity.

 

▶ Cumulative Participation Bonus: Earn additional match points based on the number of days of participation in the Danger Room.
▶ Inactivity Penalty: This match score deduction applies to Agents who have reached a certain score or higher, but have not participated for a set time.
* The inactivity Penalty applies only to Agents Platinum or above. 

 

 

 

 

- The cumulative number of days will reset if you miss one day of participation. Don’t break your streak!

 

5. Character’s stats have been changed to Tier-3, Gear +25, Skill Level 6, and New Uniforms.

In addition, effects from special equipment, Enchanted Uru, ISO-8, Comic Cards, and so on will not be applied.

* The cooldown reduction of skill cooldown time has been reduced to 50% in the Danger Room.

 

6. The AI for some of the Bosses has been improved with new attack patterns.

We are also preparing Danger Room: Extreme mode, so please look forward to it!

 

 


▣ Story Content Improvement
 
Improvements have been made to Story to provide more accurate information and deeper immersion to the Agents.

 

1. If you run out of energy while playing Story, a pop-up window will be displayed and will allow you to purchase Energy using Assemble Points. If you don’t have enough points, you can be taken to the Shop. 

 

 

2. A pop-up window with a guide will appear upon Chapter failure.

 

- Touch the continue button to start the battle again!

 

3. The urban background images during Story missions have been improved.

 

4. The difficulty of some stages have been adjusted.

 

5. Touch the [Go to Next Stage] button in the Battle Results screen to continue the Story without visiting the preparation screen.
- However, you will return to the Main Screen when moving to the next Chapter.

 

6. Only received rewards are now displayed on the Results screen when clearing a Chapter using Characters with higher levels than the first clear reward.

 

 

▣ A New Uniform Collection!


The “Hydra” Uniform Collection has been added to celebrate the arrival of the Secret Empire.
Fulfill the conditions to complete the collection and receive rewards! 

 

 

 

▣ Other Game Improvements

 

1. An issue where the Boss movement was extremely limited due to some Co-op Character skills in World Boss has been resolved. 
- The cooldown time of the World Boss Co-op Characters was increased from 3 seconds to 10 seconds.

- All World Bosses now have a Tolerance ability to combat Mind Control.
▶ Tolerance ability: The debuff duration decreases after 2 or more hits of the same debuff. Also, once a debuff has been given, they are immune to that same debuff for 5 seconds.
- The Tolerance ability occurs once every 5 seconds, with each reduction of 100%, 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% of the existing reduction up to 1 second.
* The debuff Tolerance ability is applied only to the Mind Control effect. The existing ability applied to the Cull  Obsidian World Boss has been updated to also only apply to Mind Control.

* World Boss Co-op Characters will still use only one skill, as before.

 

2. The Dimension Mission main screen has been improved to be able to immediately check the Hero Support List. 

 

3. The Character’s Tier rank, Biometrics data, and X-Gene types will now display within the Store.

 

 

4. A product search function has been added to the Store.

 

 

5. The S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy UI has been improved and recurring missions have been provided after the Agent training has been completed.

 

 

- The additional missions are divided into three mission types: Character Mission, Content Mission, and Collection.
- Earn Tier Points by completing additional missions.
- Once you complete all the provided additional missions, they will be changed to new ones.

  

 

 

-  Complete a mission after Stage 16 to receive a “Shield Academy Chest.”

 

 

- Check your current additional missions through the navigation bar!!
* The final Shield Academy mission, “Clear Sorcerer Supreme Stage 1,” has been removed.

 

 

 

- Tap the Help button to view the help list of missions you have completed.

- Select a list to check the help again.

 

6. Tapping the Custom Gear Enhancement Quest shortcut will now lead to a screen

 where only Custom Gear Enhancements are available.

 

7. The guide that triggers on the Mission selection screen when unlocking content has been improved.

- A red dot is now displayed on the content for the unlock guide, which will display after entry!

 

8. An improvement has been made to send Mutant Rank Up Materials and Titan’s Record obtained through a selector or draw to the Mailbox.

 

9. Some Epic Quest conditions have changed.
Earn Damage MVP in the Danger Room → Use 50 Energy
Earn Skill MVP in the Danger Room → Use 50 Energy
 

10. Due to exchange rate fluctuations, the purchase prices of Tony Stark’s Stash, Get 20 Biometrics Daily, and Daily Boost have been adjusted in some Android markets.
* The time of the price update may vary depending on the usage environment and situation. Please be sure to check the displayed price when purchasing a product.
 

 

▣ Other Game Error Fixes
 
1. Black Cat, Angela, and Hulkbuster acquisition guides have been improved.
2. Fixed an error that occurred upon beginning the Dimension Mission tutorial.
3. Fixed an issue in Epic Quest where the Auto-Repeat setting window would display the Hidden Ticket use information under certain conditions.
4. An issue has been resolved where the in-game buttons and the screen would not work properly when enhancing Custom Gear.
5. Fixed an issue where the Skills in the Hero Info window were not listed properly.
6. The issue where unrelated dialogue was displayed after clearing a specific content has been resolved.
7. The phenomenon where an abnormal screen was exposed upon phase change in World Boss Ultimate has been fixed.
8. The issue where Epic Quest deluxe packages that had already been purchased were locked after the update has been fixed.
9. Fixed an issue where the unlock condition for the Awakened Skill was displayed as 6★ when the Warriors of the Sky Characters are below Tier-2.
10. An issue had been confirmed where the number of Clear Tickets was not applied correctly when setting Auto-Repeat.
11. The issue where the game did not recognize the object chest which blocked the Agent from progressing to the next stage has been fixed. The box is now destructible.
12. Fixed an issue where the Character shadow was not displayed when moving via conveyor belt.
13. Fixed the issue in Story 1-1 where there was an irregular display after defeating the middle Boss.
14. The issue where the Tier- 2 Passive effect “Half-Moon Bear Spirit” was incorrectly applied to Crescent’s familiar Io has been balanced.

 

 

[Original]

Applies to: Summons

Super Armor, All Defense +5% / All Attack, Speed, Critical Rate +10%, removes Incapacitation

  

[Updated]

Applies to: Summons

Super Armor, All Defense +15% / All Attack +15% 

15. An error has been fixed where Gamora was transparent when Groot would use the Active Skill 5 in <Avengers: Infinity War>.

16. Nick Fury <Modern>’s lower body is no longer abnormally exposed.

17. The bug where some effects were continuously displayed when Luna Snow <Modern> would use Hero’s Curtain Call Active Skill 4 has been fixed.

18. The lock will now be unlocked when the inventory reaches 0 due to (something) Uru Synthesis, sale, or equipping.

19. The Ultron <Avengers: Age of Ultron> uniform model has been improved.

 

 

[Please take note of the following additional issues in January]


5. An issue has been confirmed wherein some Agent’s inventory information is looking like missing. (Currently investigating)
12. An issue has been confirmed where an additional character stat effect added to characters in the Hero Details information window is not displayed after playing Story Mission.
9. An issue has been found where a friend's set character portrait is not displayed properly in-game. (Unable to reproduce)
7. An issue has been confirmed where the Camera is fixed and does not move in certain situations when playing World Boss Ultimate. (Unable to reproduce)

 

We hope you enjoy this Hydra-centric February Update!
The next Update will be here before you know it, with even more Characters and improvements!
 
Thank you.
